title: Simultaneous Mapping of DNA Binding and Nucleosome Positioning with SpLiT-ChEC
authors: Orion G. B. Banks; Michael J. Harms; Jeffrey. N. McKnight; Laura E. McKnight
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍SpLiT-ChEC实验技术，同时绘制蛋白-DNA结合与核小体定位，但无AI或物理模拟方法，且非TF-DNA特异性结合建模，仅属实验方法，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: The organization of chromatin – including the positions of nucleosomes and the binding of other proteins to DNA – helps define transcriptional profiles in eukaryotic organisms. While techniques like ChIP-Seq and MNase-Seq can map protein-DNA and nucleosome localization separately, assays designed to simultaneously capture nucleosome positions and protein-DNA interactions can produce a detailed picture of the chromatin landscape. Most assays that monitor chromatin organization and protein binding rely on antibodies, which often exhibit nonspecific binding, and/or the addition of bulky adducts to the DNA-binding protein being studied, which can affect their expression and activity. Here, we describe SpyCatcher Linked Targeting of Chromatin Endogenous Cleavage (SpLiT-ChEC), where a 13-amino acid SpyTag peptide, appended to a protein of interest, serves as a highly-specific targeting moiety for in situ enzymatic digestion. The SpyTag/SpyCatcher system forms a covalent bond, linking the target protein and a co-expressed MNase-SpyCatcher fusion construct. SpyTagged proteins are expressed from endogenous loci, whereas MNase-SpyCatcher expression is induced immediately before harvesting cultures. MNase is activated with high concentrations of calcium, which primarily digests DNA near target protein binding sites. By sequencing the DNA fragments released by targeted MNase digestion, we found that this method recovers information on protein binding and proximal nucleosome positioning. SpLiT-ChEC provides precise temporal control that we anticipate can be used to monitor chromatin under various conditions and at distinct points in the cell cycle.
abstract_zh: 染色质的组织——包括核小体的位置以及其他蛋白质与DNA的结合——有助于定义真核生物中的转录谱。虽然像ChIP-Seq和MNase-Seq这样的技术可以分别绘制蛋白质-DNA相互作用和核小体定位，但旨在同时捕获核小体位置和蛋白质-DNA相互作用的检测方法能够产生染色质景观的详细图像。大多数监测染色质组织和蛋白质结合的检测方法依赖于抗体，这些抗体常常表现出非特异性结合，和/或需要向所研究的DNA结合蛋白添加庞大的加合物，这可能影响其表达和活性。在此，我们描述了SpyCatcher连接的染色质内源切割靶向技术（SpyCatcher Linked Targeting of Chromatin Endogenous Cleavage, SpLiT-ChEC），其中一段13个氨基酸的SpyTag肽附加到目标蛋白上，作为高度特异性的靶向部分，用于原位酶切消化。SpyTag/SpyCatcher系统形成共价键，将目标蛋白与共表达的MNase-SpyCatcher融合构建体连接起来。SpyTag标记的蛋白从内源位点表达，而MNase-SpyCatcher的表达在收获培养物前立即诱导。MNase通过高浓度钙离子激活，主要消化目标蛋白结合位点附近的DNA。通过测序靶向MNase消化释放的DNA片段，我们发现该方法能够恢复关于蛋白质结合和邻近核小体定位的信息。SpLiT-ChEC提供了精确的时间控制，我们预期其可用于监测不同条件下及细胞周期不同时间点的染色质状态。
